narration: AI does not know your answer. It guesses the next small piece of text.
caption: एआई को जवाब पता नहीं होता। वह अगले छोटे टुकड़े का अंदाज़ा लगाता है।
image_brief: A wide sheet of printed text on a dark desk, the final word missing and replaced by an empty pencil-ruled box, dim overhead light, quiet tension.

narration: Then it guesses again. Then again. It stops when the answer looks finished. Nothing else.
caption: फिर दूसरा अंदाज़ा, फिर तीसरा। जवाब पूरा लगने तक यही चलता रहता है।
image_brief: Five paper slips arranged left to right on grey slate, each one carrying a word more than the slip before it, so a sentence assembles across the row, low raking light.

narration: No plan sits behind that. No finished answer waits in a drawer to be fetched.
caption: पीछे कोई योजना नहीं। कोई तैयार जवाब कहीं रखा हुआ भी नहीं मिलता।
image_brief: An empty card index drawer pulled wide open on a library table, every slot inside bare, a brass label holder holding a blank card, cool window light.

narration: There is only a ranked shortlist of candidates, and a pick from near the top.
caption: होती है सिर्फ़ संभावित शब्दों की सूची, और उसमें से ऊपर वाला चुनाव।
image_brief: A chalkboard with five short words stacked in a column, a horizontal bar drawn beside each word shrinking downward, the longest bar at the top, warm lamplight from the right.

narration: That single trick writes essays. It writes working code. It writes apology letters too.
caption: इसी एक तरकीब से निबंध बनते हैं, कोड बनता है, माफ़ी की चिट्ठी भी।
image_brief: Three finished pages fanned across a wooden desk: an essay, a page of code, and a short formal letter, all set in the same typeface, even daylight from above.

narration: The same trick also invents facts. Smoothly. Confidently. And with no warning bell attached.
caption: यही तरकीब झूठे तथ्य भी गढ़ देती है, पूरे भरोसे के साथ।
image_brief: A printed paragraph filling the frame with a single figure ringed in red ink and a question mark inked in the wide margin beside it, hard desk lamp light.

narration: You already use this every week. Search summaries. Autocorrect. Chat assistants. Support replies. Draft emails.
caption: आप इसे हर हफ़्ते इस्तेमाल करते हैं: सारांश, ऑटोकरेक्ट, चैट, जवाबी ईमेल।
image_brief: A phone lying face up on a kitchen table showing a message box with a suggested completion in grey text above the keyboard, morning light across the table surface.

narration: It reads like someone who checked their facts first. That feeling is manufactured. Entirely.
caption: पढ़ने में लगता है किसी ने जाँच की है। वह भरोसा बनावटी है।
image_brief: A tidy typed report on a desk beside a rubber approval stamp lying on its side, the ink pad closed and dry, no mark on the paper, flat office light.

narration: Fluency is exactly what the training rewarded. Truth was never measured directly. Not once.
caption: प्रशिक्षण ने बहाव को इनाम दिया। सच को कभी सीधे नापा ही नहीं गया।
image_brief: A single polished sentence printed large on cream paper, pinned to a corkboard beside an empty checklist with no ticks in any box, soft even light.

narration: So the tone stays smooth even where the content quietly goes wrong. Same voice throughout.
caption: इसलिए लहज़ा वैसा ही रहता है, चाहे अंदर की बात सही न हो।
image_brief: A long unbroken ribbon of printed text curling across a table like a till receipt, one section shaded slightly darker than the rest, low side light.

narration: A wrong sentence and a correct one arrive in identical packaging. Same rhythm. Same confidence.
caption: सही और ग़लत वाक्य एक ही पैकिंग में आते हैं। वही लय, वही भरोसा।
image_brief: Two identical sealed envelopes side by side on dark fabric, same size, same wax seal, no label on either, one set slightly ahead of the other, soft directional light.

narration: You cannot hear the difference. Nobody can. Listening is the wrong tool for this job.
caption: अंतर सुनकर पकड़ में नहीं आता। सुनना इसका सही रास्ता नहीं है।
image_brief: A pair of over-ear headphones resting on a printed transcript, the pages showing two paragraphs marked A and B with no other difference visible, dim warm light.

narration: And that costs real money. An invented citation can cost a student a whole assignment.
caption: इसका असर असली होता है। गढ़ा हुआ हवाला पूरा असाइनमेंट ले डूबता है।
image_brief: A returned essay page on a desk with the bibliography section underlined and a large red mark beside one entry, the rest of the page untouched, cold daylight.

narration: An invented number can cost a business one very awkward meeting. Or a contract.
caption: गढ़ा हुआ आंकड़ा किसी दफ़्तर की एक बैठक भारी कर देता है।
image_brief: A boardroom table seen from one end, a printed slide left face up with one highlighted figure, chairs pushed back at odd angles, harsh ceiling light.

narration: Most explanations stop at one warning. Always verify. True, but useless on its own.
caption: ज़्यादातर बातें एक चेतावनी पर रुक जाती हैं: जाँच लो। यह अधूरा है।
image_brief: A printed notice taped to a wall reading nothing but a short warning line, its lower half torn away and missing, scuffed paint around it, flat corridor light.
